notes.title: Patch 1.2p1 available
notes.notes:
Hi! 
We uploaded a patch that fixes some small issues that we found watching streamers play the game. The game will update automagically (thx steam <3)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613649/3930ca4965eeac11e76011c1666f5b7cc51a51f4.gif[/img]

[b]If you enjoy Mr.Hack Jack, please consider leaving a review, that helps a lot![/b]

[i]Patch notes:[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with localization not appearing correctly
[*] Fixed some sounds not reacting to the sound effect mixer volume
[*] Changed the positioning of a task-giver robot to avoid some items being sucked it by the evidence gathering vortex automatically
[*] optimized some spaghetti code
[*] Fixed the physics collider on the Manneken Pis statue in stage 3
[*] Minor fixes in stage 4
[/list]

We are still investigating a crash report and will update as soon as we can fix it.

notes.title: Release date update：mid-May 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613649/a36737661d660bf94a1353eb406abeed77f679e4.png[/img]

Hello! 
Our current plan is to release Mr.Hack Jack around mid-May.

We planned for the mid-April at first, but decided to add an extra level of polish.

We're doing our best to finish the game as fast and as good as possible so stay tuned!
